pages.text: Ruins and impossible structures keep their treasure in $(item)Containment Caches$(), not chests. Each dimension seals its own kind: the Bulk Cache borrows room from a fifth dimension, the Euclid Reliquary of the Platonic Realm closes on an exact right angle, the Hilbert Locker is always full and always has room for one more.
A cache works like a chest of 27 slots; hoppers and pipes can reach it. Breaking it spills its contents and drops the cache itself. You can make an ordinary $(item)Containment Cache$() of your own.
